summary.one_liner: Diun is a tool that watches container images in registries and notifies you when a new tag or digest update is available.
summary.what_it_does: The README says Diun checks registries for new tags or digest changes so you can track base image updates, application releases, and security rebuilds without checking each repository by hand. It can run as a single executable or as a Docker image. It connects to container platforms and config files, and sends notifications through the services you already use. The README is short and high-level and does not list specific registries, platforms, or notification channels. Documentation is referenced but no link is given in the README text provided.
use_cases: get notified when Docker base images update
track new releases of self-hosted containers
catch security rebuilds of container images
notable: Checks registries for both new tags and digest changes
Runs as a single executable or as a Docker image
Sends notifications through external services the user already uses
Listed under Monitoring in an awesome-selfhost-docker list
caveats: README provided is brief and gives no install steps or detailed feature list
Documentation link is referenced but not included in the README text
Sponsorship and donation requests appear in the README but were ignored for this summary
keywords: notify me of new docker tags
